# TAP on Doge | Bitcoin Universe Protocol Reference

> Human docs: index.html
> Field reference: reference.html
> Network: Dogecoin
> Classification: TAP-compatible Dogecoin inscriptions

## Summary

A Dogecoin-facing TAP integration profile for Doginals-compatible token messages and Digital Matter Theory mint flows.

## State model

TAP-style JSON payloads inscribed through Dogecoin transaction construction and tracked by TAP on Doge-compatible readers.

## Lifecycle

1. Choose TAP asset
2. Build Doginals payload
3. Fund commit
4. Confirm indexed mint

## Operations

- Token mint: Mints an available TAP token amount using its active ticker and mint constraints.
- DMT mint: Mints a Digital Matter Theory unit using a deployment reference and block number.
- Portfolio lookup: Reads token, activity, and holder state from a compatible Dogecoin TAP reader.

## Safety

1. TAP on Doge is network-specific. Bitcoin addresses, fee assumptions, and transaction serialization do not carry over.
2. Build a mint preview from live reader metadata to confirm remaining supply, amount, and DMT deployment details.
3. This page documents the Universe integration profile. Verify third-party marketplace and indexer behavior independently.

## Sources

- Tapalytics: https://tapalytics.xyz/
- TAP Protocol documentation: https://docs.tap-protocol.com/
